text_block_list.text:
On the way back. As usual,
she invited me to stop by the park before heading home.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
"At the end of an outing with my Trainer,
I just feel like we've gotta go to the park!"

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Watching the sunset sky from here
always makes me feel like today was a fun day!
Saying that, she gazed at the twilight sky.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, we played here together before, didn't we?
That was so much fun.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
The first time I came here, too, I wanted to play,
but I ended up falling asleep, didn't I?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Right now, my body's gotten suuuper strong,
so I'm not sleepy at aall! Ehehe!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer,
you can take a nap if you're sleepy!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Mhm-mhm, get plenty of rest!
Ehehe, good night~!
Close your eyes, and after a moment...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: ...Are you asleep already?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe. Trainer's sound asleep.
All right...!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Carrot cakes... fell from the sky...
1,000 of them just rained down...!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Huh!?

Was she trying to control the dream, perhaps?
I couldn't help but chuckle.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Why!? Weren't you asleep!?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Mmph! If you were asleep, Trainer,
I was planning to carry you home on my back!
Watching her express her disappointment reminded me of the days she used to just sleep, and I felt a clear sense of growth in her.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Together? You're going to sleep too, Trainer, right?
Sounds good!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Trainer... Are you asleep already?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: ...Hey, hey, are you asleep already?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
...
Hey... Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: If you fall asleep, Trainer... I'll... give you... a piggyback ride...
She seemed to have fallen fast asleep.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: ...Mnya...

Feeling the undeniable proof of her growth
in her heavier frame, we set off on our way home.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
You're not sleepy?! Then count some carrots!
That'll put you right to sleep!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
One little carrot,
two little carrots...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: ...Seven carrots, eight carrots...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: ...I'm kind of getting hungry.
I decided to return to the academy.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Actually, my plan was to carry you home
on my back after you fell asleep, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Let's save that for next time, though!

Even with an empty stomach,
she made a dependable promise. Feeling her growth, I headed home.
